strategy.offer: Modular electronics for sensing, control, automation and power applications, plus software interfaces, accessories, kits, and electric-vehicle charging and energy-management equipment.
strategy.customers: Developers, industrial users, educational institutions, companies, municipalities and other organizations building measurement, automation, connected-device or charging installations.
strategy.why_we_win: It emphasizes an interoperable building block system, broad API support, beginner-friendly documentation, configurable event-driven operation, and strong availability through inventory and in-house production.
strategy.resources: Its basis is hardware and firmware design, software bindings, documentation, manufacturing capability, stocked components, and a modular product architecture spanning controllers, peripherals and enclosures.
strategy.direction: It is moving the platform to newer connectors and standalone networked controllers while expanding charging products with multi-unit load management and energy management.
